title: Initial query state invariant
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be any target function, and let $0<\tau\le1$ be a rational threshold. The state whose active family is the singleton containing the empty set and whose trace is empty satisfies the following at stage $0$: its active family has size at most $\lceil4/\tau^2\rceil$; every active set lies among the first zero coordinates; every set $U$ with $\tau\le|\widehat f(U)|$ has its restriction to the first zero coordinates in the active family; and every active set has restricted Fourier weight greater than $\tau^2/4$ whenever the stage is positive.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a target function from the sign cube to the signs
